Document-pullability claims were independently live-verified (not just cross-checked as facts) -- 2 of 3 claimed-pullable documents were real (Rivian/Town of Normal packets, confirmed via direct PDF download), 1 was fabricated on the first pass (OSF HFSRB CON #23-037 -- 3 plausible-looking URLs, all 404) and corrected on a feedback-loop round to 'no direct static URL, must search a dynamic database by project number.' This is the same catch-and-correct discipline as the DuPage/Cook cost-figure work, applied to document URLs instead of project facts.
